field_key.stamp: the parts each series carries in the season, measured on its rows (gate part 2)
field_key.gap: per side and part, in wins: rows, nonzero rows, sd, mean_abs, max_abs, cells whose CORE and CORE plus the part differ at one decimal, and the Spearman correlation of CORE with CORE plus the part over hitters with 300+ PA or pitchers with 50+ IP; descriptive, it decides nothing (gate part 4)
field_key.identities: the hard checks of gate part 4; a miss refuses the build

note: CORE is eWAR from the parts present in every season 2000 to 2026; FULL is eWAR as served. CORE is recorded here as per-season summaries only and is never displayed.
